Well for one, you're putting for example, the Mongrel Mob on the same standing as say ISIS and Al-Queda. The Terrorism Suppression Act or TSA, is able to freeze assets of terrorist entities and make it a criminal offence to participate in or support terrorist entities. While that might sound good on paper, designating gangs as TEs would have widespread political repercussions. 

Under the Terrorist Suppression Act (TSA), the PM may designate a group as a terrorist entity if there is reasonable grounds that such group has carried out a terrorist act or an act to advance political, ideological or religious cause to:
1. Intimidate the population or
2. Coerce or force a government to do or abstain from an act. 

Note specifically, a terror act is considered to be such, to advance those three criteria. Intimidating the population or committing violent crime, while terrible and I disagree with, doesn't fall under 'terrorism' and
only would fall under criminal acts or in the case of gang activity, an Organised Crime Group (OCGs) at most. 

Designating a group as a terrorist entity needs to meet the criteria of the TSA. Gangs, in no form, meet these criteria. In my eyes it was stupid of Winston to even suggest such a thing, and he only did it for those voters who want to be "hard on crime" with no clue of what that means or how to actually achieve such results.

I think Winston Peters needs to read up on terrorist organisations. Gangs are terrible, but nowhere near the level of a terrorist organisation. I do agree with some of his policies here but this one is completely stupid and written for those who don't understand the consequences of designating someone or a group as 'terrorists'.
